name: Plugin Manager App
author: sd88me
summary: The Open MPC Plugin Manager as an app: a Plugin Manager tile in MENU, full screen with its own tabs, instead of a plugin on a track. Patches MPC while it loads (only on the exact MPC OS 3.10.1 build it was made for; anything else is left alone). Installing it also installs Addin Restore so it survives a reboot.
